name: Grand Design
choreography: Coil the hammer above the rear shoulder; first active drives its head into the ground. The knees and hips absorb impact, one hand guides the delayed stone wave, then Hammer lifts the weapon into guard. The wave has an independent saved-lifetime animation while its caster is free to act.
requirements: Largest weapon travel from last startup to first active
Fixed anatomical scale, no decorative movement of gameplay root
Readable full-sized wave during all collision frames
Native hit, block, whiff, mirrored and caster-follow-up review
reviewCorrection: Final video replaces its second case with the separately recorded corrected mirrored case; all gameplay and clocks identical.
